sentences.text: learned counsel appearing for the appellant further submitted that the injured filed claim statement before different Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal and different Tribunal awarded compensation as against Oriental Insurance Company and some Tribunal awarded compensation as against Oriental Insurance Company as well as the Royal Sundaram Alliance Insurance Company.

Insofar as the present appeals are concerned, in C.M.A.Nos.3387, 2978, 2979, 3152, 3388 of 2012,
the Tribunal has fastened the liability upon the appellant and in C.M.A.Nos.596 to 599 and 672 of 2014, the Tribunal has fastened 80% of liability upon the appellant.
Aggrieved by the same, the appellant has preferred these appeals.

4.The learned counsel appearing for the appellant further submitted that this Court may confirm the quantum of compensation and set aside the liability issue and remand back the matter to the Exclusive Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Tirupur and permit the appellant to produce the judgment passed in other claim petition by other Tribunals and direct the respective Tribunal to provide opportunity to the appellant and claimants and pass appropriate orders.

, this Court confirms the quantum of compensation awarded by the respective Tribunal.
